prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production cutout-puppet PARTS ATLAS for Caramelka, the cheerful little goat in original mobile game Almost God.
Input image: the attached existing Caramelka is the exact character identity and material reference. Rebuild THIS SAME goat as nine SEPARATE parts for animation, no extra assembled goat.
Canvas: square 1536 by 1536, strict invisible 3 by 3 grid with generous transparent gutters. ONE isolated piece per cell. No text, no grid lines. True transparent alpha outside the pieces. Each piece stays in its own cell.
Identity: small fluffy orange-and-cream piebald goat, friendly large brown eyes, cream face stripe and muzzle, orange cheeks, small pointed ears with pink insides, cream chin beard, stout warm brown curled horns, dark cloven hooves, teal collar and golden bell. Original warm hand-painted gouache storybook style, chunky readable shapes, beautifully textured fluffy fur, polished character art.
Exact row1 left to right:
1) TORSO only, compact horizontal quadruped body facing right, orange and cream patchy long fur. NO head, NO neck sticking out, NO horns, NO tail, NO legs, NO collar or bell. Solid rounded fur-covered areas at shoulder/hip attachment points, never dark hollow sockets.
2) HEAD and short furry NECK only, three-quarter view facing right, complete ears, eye, muzzle, beard, short cream neck overlap. NO horns, NO collar, NO bell, NO torso.
3) The TWO curled brown HORNS together as a single isolated pair, arranged as they belong on this right-facing goat's head. No head or ears under them.
Exact row2 left to right:
4) FRONT LEFT leg only, fur-covered upper leg continuing to one dark cloven hoof, solid rounded upper overlap.
5) FRONT RIGHT leg only, corresponding opposite leg, fur upper leg and dark cloven hoof.
6) HIND LEFT leg only, slightly bent hock, fur upper leg and dark cloven hoof.
Exact row3 left to right:
7) HIND RIGHT leg only, corresponding opposite hind leg, fur and dark cloven hoof.
8) Short fluffy orange tail with cream tip, lifted cheerfully and curved gently upward, solid root on the right.
9) TEAL COLLAR and GOLDEN BELL as a single isolated wearable part, collar loop shaped for the short neck, bell hanging below at front, no animal fur inside it.
Constraints: All four legs are anatomically goat legs, not human limbs. Head has no duplicate horns. Body has no duplicate legs/tail. Maintain exact character palette and charm. Solid fur overlap at joints, no holes or dark cut sockets. No human hand, no clothes, no tools, no scenery, no text, no watermark.
